changes: Contacts and reminders share one confirmed collection reader/writer with authenticated transport, single in-flight operation per mounted view, a 15-second request signal, response validation, and unmount cancellation. Duplicate raw-fetch and per-operation error/state flows are removed.

Reminder create and complete use the server-returned record directly instead of an additional list GET. Failed or unconfirmed writes keep the existing list and drafts; deletion requires an explicit success response.

Contacts share one create/edit form and the backend Contact type. Phone, email and company fields now persist through create/update. Edit drafts omit notes/tags/relationship so an unrelated form edit cannot replace them.
Interaction notes belong to their contact card. The last-contact date uses lastContacted, matching the backend, instead of the unused lastInteraction field.

Contacts filter the already-loaded complete list locally, retaining name/notes/traits/tag matching and adding phone/email/company matching. Search no longer creates per-keystroke GET requests capable of overwriting a confirmed mutation.

Reminder pending/completed lists use one section renderer. Both views reset by account/role; reminders also reset by workDomain and organization identity, matching the existing authenticated backend scope.

Backend recordInteraction delegates to updateContact, sharing its owner lookup, field allowlist and persistence path without an extra database scan. Four obsolete reminder error translation entries are removed.
validationNotes: Six new cases: two collection read-retry/account-isolation scenarios; contact shared-form/save-failure/independent-note/search/create behavior; authenticated reminder create/complete/delete and duplicate-submit suppression; same-user reminder work-scope transition; isolated HTTP contact field persistence and ownership/notes preservation.

Frontend tests mount the actual panels and collection hook over the real API client with synthetic fetch. The HTTP contact test uses isolated temporary database storage and the production routes/store, including durable saves.

Initial validation found a test selecting the old Lucide Edit3 CSS alias and an incorrect UserProfile.orgId reference in the new reminder key. The button now has a translated accessible title; the key uses AppContext workDomain/orgConnection. Final focused checks and builds ran after these corrections.

Fourteen focused test files passed, along with lint/type checks, all-frontend and desktop builds, compact-layout validation and direct server bundling. Final source fingerprints preserve the latest prune40-65 baselines.
limitations: Per-view serialization does not provide cross-window synchronization. A canceled or timed-out request cannot undo a write already accepted by the server; writes are not automatically retried.
Reminders keep the backend scope derived from the authenticated token. This change isolates view state but does not introduce a new permission or storage model.

Contact notes are component drafts; changing filters to hide a contact or closing the view discards that unsaved note. Search operates on the existing non-paginated full-list contract; no large-address-book benchmark was run.

No full-suite run, real provider or user-data change, native client acceptance, commit, push or client restart. Backend build used scripts/build-server.mjs directly and did not regenerate capability documentation.
